findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "youtube" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_v1_video_comments, get_v1_community_post_details, get_v1_community_post_comments · Public sink: post_channel_videos, get_v1_community_post_details, get_v1_community_post_comments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_v1_video_comments, get_v1_community_post_details, get_v1_community_post_comments · Public sink: post_channel_videos, get_v1_community_post_details, get_v1_community_post_comments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
